reviews.t: but rather a fine line spray
reviews.x: I ordered this sprayer to use for my hair. The first on I received did not spray a mist, but rather a fine line spray. I contacted the company. They tried to help me troubleshoot, but when that didn’t work, they sent me a new one right away. The second one worked perfectly. It works great for wetting down my hair in the morning to get rid of my bedhead 😁 and reset my hair for styling.

reviews.t: A spray mist bottle for many uses, it works!
reviews.x: I love the fine mist. I use it to dampen my hair, and spray indoor plants. I purchased it because most spray bottles the size I needed were hard to squeeze. I have Arthritus and Has been difficult to use many I have tried. . This bottle is better for me, but still a little harder than I hoped. Only if you have arthritis would you understand. I am still glad I have it and the mist is great. Maybe I need to find a battery operated bottle. Maybe you could create one.

reviews.t: The ONLY SPRAY BOTTLE YOU WILL EVER NEED!
reviews.x: This product is worth the money in so many ways. #1 - Quality is above and beyond way better than your regular ole Sally’s beauty spray bottle.  #2 - I was so surprised on how amazing the release of the spray works. For example, You can spray it once with just water in it and it literally can cover your whole head with just movement. How awesome is that!  #3 - The bottle itself is very easy to use and clean if you using more than just water in it.  #4 -  Shocked about the Amazing customer servic

I wouldn’t call the mist ultra-fine, but it works well enough for my home-made sanitizer/deodorizer.  So far, no leaks and does spray continuously with very light pumping action.  I am considering buying more, but I’d like to see first if this bottle would hold up to continous use.
Was just as expected. It mists really well, and was just the right size.

reviews.t: being more expensive I thought I was paying for a better product, but the bottle is TINY
reviews.x: I ordered this product because it looked aesthetically nicer than other products, being more expensive I thought I was paying for a better product, but the bottle is TINY, def not worth the price for the size.

I got my hair permed about 3 weeks ago and have been in search of a mister for the in-between washing days.  I was using a cheap spray bottle but got frustrated when it stopped working.  This is definitely worth the price.  The mist is amazing and the bottle is stylish looking.  Highly recommend.

I so wish top screwed on better, at least having to go around once or twice. Instead it is a half turn and a click. It most certainly is not something I would travel with due to this feature, however, it is fine for the counter-top. It does have a bit of a stick when pulling the trigger, which makes for a hard pull, however, it does work, so I figure this is just the way it was made. It has a nice mist, hence the 4-star rating. Time will tell how long this product will last.

I bought this water bottle to spray the leaves of my houseplants, and the mist that comes out is perfect. I don't have to worry about water accidently getting onto tabletops or other things in my home or my office. I bought one for my father-in-law to mist his parrot's feathers, knowing how softly the mist comes out, and he said it works perfectly and his parrot loves it! By giving you the ability to effortlessly spray and mist, you'll certainly say goodbye to your continuous hand movements of cranking on the trigger. I use this spray bottle for both my hair and misting my plants. I remember seeing it pop up in every YouTube video and thought (just like you, I'm sure), it's an empty water bottle, why is it $15? Initially, I just like the unique look of it and ease when holding it, but the continuous spray is AMAZING! I have two girls, 5 and 1 with curly hair so water bottles are a must. Used it once or twice a day during weekdays. Worked beautifully for about 9 months then the trigger abruptly went from smooth to jammed. I kept on using it because the nozzle was still spraying the mist correctly. That is until today. Now there is just a jet stream that comes out. I will be more than happy to maintain or repair the no

[[VIDEOID:cf723429eb529f63726e49ba462c2a4a]] Got this after seeing a youtuber using as a plant mister! Had for a few days now, still working great! Creates a perfect spray of mist for covering your plants quickly! Its actually really fun to spray too, haha. I plan to try and clear the spray nozzle frequently to hopefully avoid the mildewy odor that other reviewers have mentioned (remove top and spray until its clear of water!) Will update if my opinion changes down the road for this item!

I had purchased a cheaper misting sprayer about 2 years ago and it stopped spraying.  I actually didn't check the sprayer to see if the head got clogged.  I tried this one which was about 25% more expensive than the previous one and I used it twice so far.  I notice that it does feel a bit more substantial and the spray is stronger, but it can be controlled by the amount I pull the spray trigger.  I am also using distilled water in it and hope it will last longer.

This worked great for two months spraying a perfect fine mist but all the sudden it started spraying a stream of water instead.  It wouldn’t really bother me if it were only a two dollar spray bottle but it was $15.  I wish there was a way to contact the company and speak to their customer service. I’ve only had it two months! I would really like a replacement if it all possible. I’m so sad that it doesn’t work anymore.
The inside of this bottle STUNK when I bought it, and no amount of sanitizing or cleaning was able to get rid of the smell. Ended up throwing it away. Don't waste your money.

reviews.t: Exceeded my expectations. Never going back to a standard ...
reviews.x: Exceeded my expectations. Never going back to a standard trigger sprayer. This sprayed oura out a get amount of product. Steady  solid stream.
I use this to spray homemade nonstick cooking oil (half olive oil, half water). It sprays out nicely and coats pans evenly. Very pleased.

It doesn't drip out while spraying/misting like other spray bottles do. IF they made this TALLER, to hold 10-12 ounces that might be better.  BUT then the top half that houses the hose/spray mechanism would be too long then!  It DOES WORK. It DOES spray a mist.  Works for me to moisten my natural hair when it gets dry.  I will keep the two I bought. The Continuous Spray part is not a

reviews.t: Works great for about a year!
reviews.x: Worked great for about a year, at which time the pump stopped working as intended. Water still comes out, but only a small amount with each pump of the trigger and there is no longer a continuous spray. Now I have to squeeze the trigger repeatedly like a regular spray bottle, but with less results, and the trigger is now so hard to push that my hand quickly tires. For the price, and getting a whole year's use out of it, I guess it performed well, just don't expect it to last forever. I will prob

love this!  I had originally bought it to put in a spray solution that I use on my muscles to treat cramps--because the sprayer will spray in any position and I needed a bottle that sprayed upside down. Sadly, I can't use the solution in it--it can only handle water. But in the process, I fell in love with using it for water to spray on my hair (just exactly how it is marketed--duh!).  This is great!  I just wish they would make one that I could use for an oil-based solution--it would be perfect

reviews.t: A must for curly hair refresh days!
reviews.x: I love this bottle. My hair is long and curly and when I would have to refresh using the spritz bottle, my fingers would hurt and i would end up semi wetting my hair because I just couldn’t bother. With this bottle I can spritz all of my hair to a nice soak in maybe less than a minute with even water distribution, put some leave in conditioner in 30 seconds or less and then leave the house. This is an amazing buy for curly hair! A must!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the fine, even mist and continuous spray for uses like hair, plants, and household tasks.
Several reviewers find the bottle worth the price and a quality upgrade over ordinary spray bottles.
A few reviewers report durability or reliability problems, including a jammed trigger, a bottle that rarely works, and a defective first unit.
Some reviewers note the bottle is smaller than expected or not worth the price for its size.
A few reviewers mention minor design drawbacks such as a hard-to-squeeze trigger or a top that screws on loosely.

qa.q: Will this bottle fit my existing spray nozzle?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is the plastic durable enough for daily use?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: some report the trigger or pump failing after about 9 months to a year [1][4], while others describe it as feeling more substantial than cheaper sprayers and worth the price [2][6].

claims.text: One reviewer reports the trigger jammed after about 9 months of daily weekday use [1].
Another reviewer reports the pump stopped working as intended after about a year [4].
Some reviewers say it feels more substantial than cheaper sprayers and is worth the price [2][6].

qa.q: Does the bottle have a smell or plastic odor?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer reports the bottle "STUNK" inside and that cleaning could not remove the smell [1], while another mentions reading critiques about mildew odor and plans to use distilled water to keep it clean [2].

qa.q: Is it safe for storing cleaning chemicals or oils?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it good value for the price?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: one reviewer felt it was not worth the price because the bottle is tiny [2], while another noted it lasted about a year for the price [5]. Others describe it as more substantial and stronger than a cheaper sprayer [1] and worth buying after hesitating over the $15 price [4].
